summary.text: Sam Farrington (listed by Ballotpedia as Samuel Farrington) is a Republican state representative for Strafford 8 who is seeking re-election in New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Farrington graduated from Spaulding High School, and his career experience includes working on his family's farm.
As of March 2025, he attended the University of New Hampshire.
Farrington defeated incumbent Chuck Grassie in the general election for Strafford 8 on November 5, 2024, and took office on December 4, 2024.
On September 8, 2026, he advanced from the Republican primary for Strafford 19, a three-seat district, together with Jonathan Verbicky and James Higginbottom.
